images.inspection: Opened full native-resolution image with view_image detail original; inspected entire composition and visible dog anatomy/coat.
findings: Neet has four individually readable supported paws, fine leg shafts, a full narrow trunk with real belly clearance, visible neck, broad pointed ears and tiny rump nub. His mild head turn remains connected to the shoulder line.

Buddy has four owned legs attached to a continuous moderately elongated torso, substantial legs and space under the belly. His dark tapering tail reaches the right wall; it has no plume or ring. Sock is held at the mouth and hangs freely without merging with a paw.

Both torso surfaces are broad smooth color planes with clean short-coat silhouettes. Buddy retains pale irregular outward/downward moustache strands, a modest beard, light eyebrows, hanging ear furnishings and distal paw hair. No engraved curls or shag volume on the torso.

Closed bedroom door, blue predawn hall, absent humans and sock still in Buddy’s mouth match the state after the tail-thump dignity exchange and before Sagar opens the door. Neet’s serious sidelong look against Buddy’s expectant gift-bearing face carries the joke. Warm hallway light is compatible with predawn indoors.
Ground contacts, floor shadows and perspective agree. Full dog silhouettes remain separated; no stray limbs or unfinished edge artifacts found.

findings: Neet’s upright seated chest connects to his supported forelegs and folded hindquarters; broad triangular ears remain separate from the cone. Torso remains full and narrow; nub is hidden by seated view rather than replaced by a long tail.

Buddy’s raised forepaw has one continuous shoulder/elbow/wrist chain; the opposite foreleg and both hindlegs supply three unambiguous ground contacts. Neck, elongated torso and pelvis connect and keep genuine underside clearance.

Buddy’s pale moustache is irregular and furnished, with modest beard, brows and hanging ears retained. Smooth charcoal trunk has broad clean tonal planes, no curling engraved body strokes or enlarged shag. Tail has modest edge fringe consistent with the guide, not a plume.

Buddy’s party cone visibly obscures one eye; his other eye and open smile remain readable. Neet’s still offended expression contrasts with Buddy’s lifted anticipatory prance. This reads as the hat reaction before the next prose action.

All four cake candles have bare unlit wick tips, without flames or glow. Evening window and indoor warm light fit the feast scene before Heather lights candles. The cake remains distant on the table; no feeding is depicted.
Furniture scale, rug contacts, hats and elastic line are legible and do not merge with anatomy. No material finish defect found.

Raised neck and projecting muzzle turn coherently toward the sock. Pale irregular moustache/beard, light brows and regional ear furnishings match Buddy; smooth dark torso remains free of curl engraving or shag volume. Distal leg/paw and face furnishings remain localized.
Dark tapering tail lies behind the folded rump with modest fringe. Body length stays moderate and head remains proportionate to this closer low view.

Sagar’s cropped clothed legs and hand holding a grey sock above the cushion match the exact final state after “Buddy lifted his head” and before the sock is laid beside Sagar. Human likeness is provisional; crop avoids claiming a facial reference. Visible grip and fingers read plausibly.

Warm evening lamplight, sofa and backyard points of light support the quiet gift payoff. Low close composition adds a distinct emotional scene after wide hallway and mid-distance hats, without repeating their gag.
Smooth dog color planes coexist with textured upholstery/rug; that environmental texture does not imply long body fur. No material support, overlap or finish defect found.
